entry.title: Tintagel Castle

terrainReference.basis: Native Y=0 is the retained standard PMTiles terrain at the mapped bridge midpoint. Roofless ruins follow the coarse hillside; bridge deck and short terraces are picture-led estimates.

entry.note: PMTiles bridge centerline controls scale and orientation; information points identify rooms but do not survey their plans. Surviving walls and courtyard levels are explicitly approximate. The road suppression outline extends 0.1 m beyond each mapped bridge end to cover projection rounding; approach height hints are intentionally unset because native east/south axes differ from the skew bridge axis. Exact grade-path joins remain unverified. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
